name: Intuitive Machines

overview.value: Intuitive Machines is an American space exploration company headquartered in Houston, Texas, founded in 2013 by Stephen Altemus, Kam Ghaffarian, and Tim Crain. The company provides commercial and government exploration of the Moon, including lunar surface access for transportation and payload delivery, data transmission services, and infrastructure-as-a-service. NASA has awarded Intuitive Machines five lunar surface delivery task orders through its Commercial Lunar Payload Services (CLPS) initiative. The company went public in February 2023 after merging with Inflection Point Acquisition Corp., a special-purpose acquisition company, and trades on Nasdaq under the ticker symbol LUNR.

focus.value: Commercial and government lunar exploration: lander delivery, data transmission, and infrastructure-as-a-service
